fullPassage: Work stress has increased significantly over the past two decades, a development mostly driven by an intensification of psychological job demands. In a comparable trend, the psychological demands surrounding training and competition in sport have increased, and these demands will likely only increase further. Maintaining the delicate balance between stress and recovery is essential for individuals to achieve optimal health, well-being, and performance. In contrast, insufficient recovery from the demands of work or sport can lead to prolonged stress reactions and chronic strain, which can ultimately lead to diverse negative outcomes. For example, employees are at risk of occupational burnout, lower productivity, a higher rate of sickness absence, and an earlier exit from the labour force. To reduce stress, many companies have introduced in-house yoga programs and flexible working hours for their employees. Likewise, potential consequences of prolonged stress and chronic strain for athletes are underrecovery, overtraining syndrome, decreased performance, and ill-health.

"일식의 원인은 궁극적으로 밤과 낮의 교대의 원인과 같다."

→ The reason for eclipses is __________ the same as that of the succession of night and day.

[조건] ultimately를 사용할 것 (1단어)

det.analysis: ✅ ultimately: 원문 is ultimately the same as에서 빈칸에 해당

questions.passage: Work stress has increased significantly over the past two decades, a development mostly driven by an intensification of psychological job demands. In a comparable trend, the psychological demands surrounding training and competition in sport have increased, and these demands will likely only increase further. ____ In contrast, insufficient recovery from the demands of work or sport can lead to prolonged stress reactions and chronic strain, which can ultimately lead to diverse negative outcomes. For example, employees are at risk of occupational burnout, lower productivity, a higher rate of sickness absence, and an earlier exit from the labour force. To reduce stress, many companies have introduced in-house yoga programs and flexible working hours for their employees. Likewise, potential consequences of prolonged stress and chronic strain for athletes are underrecovery, overtraining syndrome, decreased performance, and ill-health.
questions.stem: 다음 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. Maintaining / individuals / and / recovery / is / to / for / between / achieve / well-being, / performance. / balance / essential / optimal / stress / and / delicate / health, / the

det.korean: For the physicist, understanding the ordinary, the habitual, and the frequent thus allows us to account for the frightening and the singular
det.analysis: ✅ For the physicist + understanding(동명사 주어) + allows us to account for 구조
det.tip: 동명사 주어 + 단수 동사: Understanding ... allows

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ bizarre: 특이하고 두려운 현상이라는 맥락에서 기이한이 적합
❌ ① predictable: 예측 가능한은 문맥상 반대
❌ ② ordinary: 평범한은 글의 대비 구조에 맞지 않음
❌ ③ minor: 사소한은 broad range와 어울리지 않음
